vars.name: Max temperature
vars.define: The day's highest air temperature 2 m above the ground, averaged over the year.

vars.name: Rainfall
vars.define: Total rain and snow (as water) that falls in a year.

vars.name: Humidity
vars.define: Relative humidity 2 m above the ground: how close the air is to saturation, yearly average.

vars.name: Soil moisture
vars.define: How wet the root zone (top ~1 m of soil) is: 0 = bone dry, 1 = saturated. Yearly average.

vars.name: Wind speed
vars.define: Average wind speed 10 m above the ground.

vars.name: Vegetation greenness
vars.define: NDVI from MODIS: about 0 for bare ground, 0.2–0.5 for grass and crops, above 0.6 for dense forest. Average of the months that are observed in most years.

vars.name: Fire detections
vars.src: NASA FIRMS MODIS + VIIRS, unified (Ember Atlas)
vars.define: Active-fire detections per year in VIIRS-equivalent units: MODIS calibrated to VIIRS so all 25 years are on one scale.

vars.name: Forest loss
vars.define: Share of the square's area where tree cover was lost that year (2001–2024).
